review_candidates.title: Ingeniero/a de Control de Proyectos
review_candidates.description: Job Description No hay promesa más importante que cuidar nuestro medio ambiente; nosotros estamos comprometidos con esta causa y te ayudaremos a hacerlo. Únete a nosotros en nuestro esfuerzo por garantizar un futuro sostenible para nuestras comunidades y el mundo en que vivimos. Forma parte de nuestra red mundial de ingenieros, científicos, urbanistas y especialistas ambientales, que trabajan juntos para que este mundo sea cada día mejor. Nuestra promesa para ti Únete a GHD Esta es la #FuerzadelCompromiso. En GHD buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a Control de Proyectos . El rol está orientado principalmente a desarrollar y ejecutar actividades de planificación y control de proyectos, incluyendo la elaboración, actualización y seguimiento de programas, proyección de recursos, medición del avance físico y análisis del desempeño de los proyectos. Estas funciones podrán abarcar proyectos de ingeniería de distinta escala y complejidad, sean independientes ( stand alone ) o que obedezcan a contratos marco. Asimismo, será responsable de identificar desviaciones respecto del plan, anticipando posibles alertas relacionadas con plazos, recursos y avance, así como también de apoyar la preparación de proyecciones, reportes y análisis que faciliten la toma de decisiones del equipo de proyecto. Deberá apoyar el control de cambios evaluando tempranamente el impacto del cambio en el programa del proyecto si así procede. El rol deberá aplicar las directrices, procesos, procedimientos y sistemas establecidos por GHD para la planificación y control de proyectos, contribuyendo a mantener información actualizada, consistente y confiable sobre el estado y las proyecciones de cada Proyecto. Este rol está basado en Santiagp, bajo una modalidad de trabajo híbrida y reporta a la jefatura funcional de Planificación y Control de la compañía. Requisitos Ingeniero(a) Civil (cualquier especialidad) titulado Al menos 7 años de experiencia comprobable en Control de Proyectos en proyectos de Minería e Infraestructura Fuerte ética de trabajo, responsabilidad y compromiso Proactividad Excelente trato y comunicación con todos los niveles de profesionales y directivos Experiencia en planificación de ingeniería para propuestas Experiencia en planificación y control de proyectos de ingeniería en sus diferentes etapas, para proyectos de distinto tamaño y nivel de complejidad Experiencia en proyectos stand alone y en carteras de proyectos atendiendo varios contratos al mismo tiempo (contratos marco) Experiencia en manejo de presupuesto de horas, análisis de retrasos y reprogramaciones, control de variaciones contractuales, conocimientos en curvas S y ruta crítica Habilidades blandas y proactividad en gestión con líderes de disciplinas de ingeniería Experiencia en reportabilidad interna y externa Manejo avanzado de P6 y MS Project (excluyente) Manejo avanzado de Excel (excluyente) Experiencia en control de costos (deseable) Manejo deseable de Power BI Inglés nivel intermedio (deseable nivel alto) Como organización multicultural, fomentamos los logros individuales y reconocemos la fortaleza de una fuerza laboral diversa. En GHD nos regimos por la Ley de Inclusión Laboral (Ley N° 21.015). review_candidates.description: FOR FULL CONSIDERATION, ALL APPLICANTS MUST COMPLETE AN APPLICATION ON THE COMPANY WEBSITE AT: CAREERS.THECHA.ORG (applying on LinkedIn only DOES NOT complete the application process - you MUST complete an application on our careers website) Position Summary The Budget Director supports the Deputy Chief in the development, administration, forecasting and monitoring of CHA’s annual operating budget and the capital needs plan. The position directs the day-to-day work of Budget team staff; oversees budget monitoring, financial analysis, and executive reporting; coordinates required HUD budget and funding submissions; and monitors the allocation and use of operating and capital resources. Duties And Responsibilities Directly supervises assigned Budget team staff and is responsible for assigning and reviewing work, providing training and guidance, monitoring performance and completing performance evaluations. Coordinates the preparation and submission of required budget document and funding forms to HUD. Leads Budget team activities with the transition from Lawson to Yardi, including implementation and ongoing use of budget, forecasting, capital-planning, workflow, and reporting function. Manages Yardi Jobs request, review, approval, and revision workflows to ensure adherence to CHA policy, appropriate funding allocation, and accurate tracking of all capital funding sources and uses; includes migration into Yardi Forecast IQ for operating budget management, compilation, and reporting. Directs the development of revenue and expenditure forecasts for CHA programs and coordinates monthly variance analysis and explanations with budget staff and user groups. Directs the development and updating of the five-year capital needs plan using information provided by leadership and applicable user departments. Assigns capital funding sources to projects and provide monthly reporting that include budget versus actual, commitment & spend status of various capital funds, and other ad hoc reporting needs. Supervises and directs day-to-day departmental activities to ensure smooth and efficient operations. Oversee processes to ensure that expenditures have proper approval and have been budgeted. Directs the preparation and review of monthly budget to actual reports, forecasts, and financial analyses for executive leadership and operating departments. Participates in and directs strategic planning initiatives to ensure overall goals and objectives of the departments are met. Oversees preparation of program applications related to operating subsidy and capital grants and assists in completing budget-related portions of HUD Annual Plan and Report submissions. Monitors available financial resources and anticipates future funding requirements for review with the Deputy Chief of Budgets. Monitors relevant trends, developments, and federal regulations to ensure accurate maintenance of budgets authority-wide. Reviews program contract agreements relative to financial issues to ensure funds are allocated accordingly. Performs other related duties consistent with the purpose and level of the position. Qualifications This position requires considerable knowledge of accounting and budget practices and procedures, knowledge of HUD budget and accounting regulations, financial reporting practices, effective analytical, problem-solving, and communications skills, and a general working knowledge of manual and automated accounting and budget maintenance systems. Familiarity with Yardi ERP would be a plus. This position also requires a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Mathematics, or Business Administration, and a minimum of seven (7) years’ progressive, responsible experience in an accounting environment or the equivalent of education and related work experience. CPA or MBA preferred. Benefits At-a-glance Vacation, Sick and Personal, competitive PTO package Medical (HMO, PPO, and No employee cost High-Deductible PPO) Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance Long-Term Care Insurance Pet Insurance Parking Transit Prepaid Legal Services Brightstar 529 College Savings Plan Identity Theft Protection Hospital Indemnity Insurance Voluntary Critical Illness Insurance Deferred Compensation Plan: Empower 457/401(a) with a 3% employer match Pension Plan: CHA makes contributions on behalf of the employee, along with the employee's 3% contribution; 100% vesting occurs after 6 years of continuous employment or opt-out of CHA's Retirement Plan and continues to participate in the Municipal Employees Annuity and Benefit Fund of Chicago Hybrid work schedule (position specific) This position may be eligible for remote work following a successful completion of a 90-day probationary period according to CHA’s established policies and procedures. "Applications will be accepted for 30 days from the date of posting. However, the position may be closed at any point if a sufficient number of qualified applications are received.” Salary Range: $140,000 - $145,000 Grade: S10 FLSA: Exempt Union: None FOR FULL CONSIDERATION, ALL APPLICANTS MUST COMPLETE AN APPLICATION ON THE COMPANY WEBSITE AT: CAREERS.THECHA.ORG (applying on Indeed only DOES NOT complete the application process - you MUST complete an application on our careers website)
